contracts.action: Row click skips the toggle when text is selected
contracts.equivalent_path: The same row onClick handler, which toggled on any click outside the input
contracts.before_after: Before: a drag-select over a file name ended in a click that toggled the row. After: the handler returns early when window.getSelection() has text. A plain click collapses the selection on mousedown, so it still toggles.
contracts.visible_effect: Copying a name no longer ticks or unticks the row. A normal click on the row still toggles it.
contracts.failure_mode: window.getSelection() can return null, and the optional chaining handles that. No async work is involved.

thread_replies.reply: Addressed. The row click handler at reconcile-dialog.tsx:216 returns early when `window.getSelection()` has text. The test covers it by mocking a selection, clicking the row and checking the box keeps its state.
